summary: Preserved PR 2036's scoped NIXL clear and refusal of unusable suffixes, while correcting its occurrence-based matcher. Cache ownership is now recognized only when the requested instance suffix begins immediately after the production 64-character SHA-256 page key, preventing shorter model names from matching the tail of longer model names for both ranked non-MLA and unranked MLA suffixes.
